schema:location.schema:name: Plasma Analytical Facility, Florida State University, Tallahassee FL, USA

schema:creator.schema:name: Zhang, Chabot, Rubin, Humayun et al.

ada:samplePreparationMethodDefault: Polished metal slabs and thin sections; no acid treatment described
ada:laserManufacturerModel: ESI New Wave UP193FX (193 nm Nd:YAG frequency-quintupled solid state)
ada:detectorConfiguration: Triple mode detection (pulse counting + analog + Faraday) at 65% duty cycle
ada:laserSpotGeometryDefault: Raster: 50 µm circular beam spot; Spot (Ge): 150 µm circular
ada:laserSpotPathAblationMode: Raster area (2D mapping) for most irons; Spot (stationary) for Ge analysis on 5 irons
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: Standards at start of session → raster unknowns → repeat → standards at end; separate session for Ge spot analyses
ada:internalStandardApproach: Standardization techniques followed those of Humayun (2012) [Section 2.2; specific IS approach not restated in this paper]
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Multi-point external calibration using series of iron meteorite reference materials (North Chile Filomena as primary standard for Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/Ga/Ge/As/W/Au; Hoba for Ru/Rh/Pd/Re/Os/Ir/Pt; NIST SRM 1263a V-Cr steel for V/Cr/Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/As/Mo/W/Au)
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Gas blank measured before each raster analysis; mean background subtracted
ada:isobaricInterferenceCorrectionsAppli: Yes — ⁹⁹Ru used instead of ¹⁰¹Ru to avoid ⁴⁰Ar⁶¹Ni⁺ interference; isotope selection minimizes other interferences
ada:interferingSpecies: ⁴⁰Ar⁶¹Ni⁺ on ¹⁰¹Ru (most abundant Ru isotope → use ⁹⁹Ru instead)
ada:interferenceCorrectionMethod: Isotope selection: ⁹⁹Ru chosen over ¹⁰¹Ru; other isotopes chosen to minimize interference
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: North Chile Filomena (IIAB iron meteorite; Wasson et al. 1989) for Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/Ga/Ge/As/W/Au; Hoba (IVB; Walker et al. 2008) for Ru/Rh/Pd/Re/Os/Ir/Pt; NIST SRM 1263a V-Cr steel (Campbell & Humayun 2005) for V/Cr/Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/As/Mo/W/Au
ada:calibrationStandardMeasurementFreque: Standards at start and end of session; external bracketing
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: LA-ICP-MS concentrations agreed with NAA within ±40% for most elements (LA relative to NAA); within ±10% for Ni, Co, Ga; differences in W (4.39 vs 1.06 ng g⁻¹ for Cerro del Inca by LA vs INAA) and Au/As up to 30% — attributed to heterogeneous sampling scale difference between techniques
